posting_text:
Mechanical Engineer II, Fulfillment Robotics
Job ID: 2817734 | Westborough, MA, USA

DESCRIPTION
Our team designs end-of-arm tooling for industrial robotics cells in our fulfillment centers. You will partner with controls engineers who program PLCs and FANUC robots.

Key job responsibilities
- Design sheet metal and machined components in SolidWorks
- Perform tolerance stack-up analysis and FEA on new fixtures
- Support pilot builds and drive root cause analysis of field failures

About the team
Our team of 40 engineers works out of Westborough, MA and runs Agile sprints.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering
- 3+ years of experience with 3D CAD (SolidWorks, Creo or CATIA)
- Experience applying GD&T per ASME Y14.5

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering
- Experience with Python or MATLAB for test data analysis
- Familiarity with DFM/DFA principles

Our inclusive culture empowers employees to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation during the application process, please visit our accommodations page.

Pay range: the base pay for this position ranges from $98,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $160,000/year in our highest geographic market.
